equation_family.parameter_open: Disc_t(Q) is nonzero and 4*a4^3+27*b6^2 is nonzero.  Then Q has eleven simple nonzero roots, the fiber at infinity is smooth, and all twelve singular fibers of R are I1.
equation_family.very_general_full_Picard: NS(X)=U+E8(-2)+<-2> for a very general parameter
equation_family.weak_carrier_scope: Equation-level refers to the ambient K3 surface. An F-marking makes every transported wall an algebraic divisor class in full NS; it does not provide equations, effective representatives, or irreducible curves for arbitrary transported classes.

full_reflection_group.name: W(F)=W_r(11,9,1)
full_reflection_group.proof_of_subgroup_criterion: For a genuine Coxeter polyhedron P, the Coxeter-Poincare theorem makes P a fundamental domain of its facet group Gamma. Primitive reduction puts every facet reflection in W(F), so Gamma<=W(F). A Gamma domain is a disjoint union modulo boundaries of [W(F):Gamma] W(F)-chambers; hence its volume is finite iff the index is finite. A finite-index subgroup of the nonuniform W(F) contains powers of parabolic elements and is nonuniform, so P cannot be compact.

lattice.alphabet_scope: These are the exhaustive possibilities for primitive negative vectors defining hyperbolic mirrors. They do not classify positive-norm integral lattice reflections.
lattice.name: F=U+E8(-2)+<-2>

promotion_boundary.full_nef_criterion: After the chamber-specific Weyl re-marking, full-nef equality holds exactly when every irredundant facet is a primitive (-2)-root hyperplane and no other (-2)-root hyperplane meets the chamber interior.
promotion_boundary.minus_four_obstruction: An irredundant primitive (-4,div2) facet cannot be a full K3 nef wall, though it remains an integral divisor reflection.
promotion_boundary.minus_two_effectivity: For each chamber separately, a Weyl re-marking moves a generic strict interior point into the ample cone; K3 Riemann--Roch then makes every oriented (-2) facet effective.
promotion_boundary.reducibility: An effective (-2) class may be reducible and therefore need not define an actual nef facet.
promotion_boundary.volume_gate: The family supplies no volume conclusion. Use either a separate complete Vinberg endpoint/parabolic audit or an independent proof of finite index in W(F).

theorem.common_equation_family_criterion: Every genuine finite-sided oriented H10 Coxeter polyhedron admitting a realization by primitive negative vectors whose reflections preserve F=U+E8(-2)+<-2> is a weak equation-level full-Picard divisor carrier, after choosing an F-marking of a very general member of the displayed nine-parameter K3 family.
theorem.compact_no_go_inside_F: No compact H10 Coxeter polytope admits an oriented primitive negative integral-mirror realization in F.
theorem.converse_for_this_marked_family: Every primitive negative Picard vector defining an integral hyperbolic mirror reflection on a very general marked member has type (-2,div1), (-2,div2), or (-4,div2). Positive-norm integral lattice reflections are outside this mirror alphabet.
theorem.finite_volume_subgroup_criterion: Let W(F) be the hyperbolic group generated by all primitive negative integral mirror reflections of F. Its complete 13-wall chamber has finite volume and four cusps. For a genuine Coxeter polyhedron P which is the fundamental domain of its facet-reflection group Gamma<=W(F), vol(P) is finite exactly when [W(F):Gamma] is finite; every such P is noncompact.
proof_inputs: the explicit family has very-general NS exactly F
the primitive K3 embedding of F supplies the marked period space
a primitive vector has divisibility dividing exp(A_F)=2
reflection integrality is equivalent to |v^2| dividing 2*div(v)
a genuine Coxeter polyhedron is a fundamental domain for its facet-reflection group
